facts.text: French traders founded Fort Rouillé in 1750 on what is now the Exhibition grounds, but abandoned it in 1759 during the Seven Years' War.
The abandoned lower platform of Bay station, known as Lower Bay, is still used today for filming subway scenes in movies and TV shows.
Toronto’s lower production costs and diverse neighborhoods make it a top destination for film and television, earning it the nickname “Hollywood North.”.
The Toronto Argonauts, founded in 1873, are the oldest continuously operating professional football team in North America and play in the CFL.
A 19th‑century distillery built by Gooderham and Worts became Canada’s largest whisky factory, and its buildings now form the historic Distillery District.
Because Lake Ontario is cooler in spring and early summer, many afternoons in New Toronto feel noticeably cooler thanks to the lake breeze.
